description: Rapid99, of Joker, created this outfit for the Almost Famous 2013 contest. It’s perfect for the fashion conscious roving radio broadcaster and mercenary!

Onishema, of Joker, created this Bruise Tooth outfit for the Almost Famous 2013 contest. It’s part racing suit, part branding exercise and it’s got a very striking visual style.

Love, of Joker, created this outfit for the Almost Famous 2013 contest. Retro-Joker designs make it the perfect outfit for the discerning hipster.
